Episode 200. The Secret of the Vermont Royal Family (1)
The dimensional gate that Rakiman Hogg opened with his bracelet led to the enemy tribe's castle, the launch site of Patlok's warship.
Close to a thousand warships were waiting at the launch site, where the flames of Upwha had fallen along with the fleeing enemy tribe.
The enemy tribe had no choice but to face the chaos upon their return. The uncontrollable Upwha was spreading wildly, swallowing up various parts of the launch site.
"Put out the fire, disperse, and activate the emergency shields on the warships!"
Shimat took command in place of the unconscious Rakiman.
He was also at his limit, but if he fell now, it would be the end of Patlok's red fleet.
"Destroy the warships that are already on fire to prevent them from spreading. And quickly take our brother Rakiman to the infirmary!"
If the King-grade enemy tribes weren't exhausted, putting out the remnants of the Upwha fire wouldn't be this challenging.
They had no choice but to continue. The enemy tribe shed tears of blood as they destroyed the warships engulfed by Upwha.
Fortunately, in the midst of misfortune, the properties of the Eternal Flame were not in the Upwha.

The enemy tribe managed to suppress the fire after losing nearly a hundred warships. After all the remnants of Upwha were extinguished, Shimat and the tribes sat down for a while with blank expressions.
They had lost too much in a single battle.
'Why did Jin Runcandel come out from there... After the disaster, the temporary alliance on the ground was dissolved, and they had returned to a hostile relationship.'
It was a series of events that Shimat couldn't understand.
Jin Runcandel's sudden appearance in the Kinzelo branch, and Rakiman's decision to confront him in battle.

Shimat had repeatedly warned Rakiman. Even if they encounter Jin Runcandel or another transcendent during the hunt, they should retreat first. They are not as strong as they used to be, and the ground is full of strong individuals.
There was no time to run. If they could summon the fleet, they could have used the return spell by sacrificing the prey or the lower tribes in the Kinzelo branch.
"Incompetent bug... losing the fleet for not properly handling such a task."
Suddenly, Shimat spat out an insult, causing Andolin and Ojen nearby to look at him in surprise.
"Brother Shimat?"
Shimat himself was surprised at his words. He unconsciously thought of Rakiman as a subordinate and blurted out the offensive words.
"......I was talking to myself."
Andolin and Ojen felt uncomfortable, but they did not ask any further.
"We must first find out what happened to Jin Runcandel and Kinzelro. Whether there was just some kind of trade or if they have allied again."
"I will make sure to verify it during our next mission."

"We need to wake the other Great War King brethren quickly. As soon as Rakiman's treatment is finished, we have to check on the other castles. To counter the power of Jin Runcandel... at least Great War King Bakarun or the deity brethren need to wake up."
"The castle of Bakarun is likely to be sealed like us. But the deity... he disappeared suddenly even when we were active."
"Lately, I've been thinking that the deity might have disappeared because he foresaw this kind of seal situation."
It was an out-of-the-blue remark, but Andolin and Ojen didn't deny it. Shimat always showed competence, and his words, often laughed at, turned out to be true many times.
However, they could not fully accept the fact that the enemy tribe's 'deity' was afraid of the seal and left his brethren to hide alone.

"Among the other Great War King brethren, there may be someone who knows the whereabouts of the deity brothers. Even if not, we cannot revive if the Great War King brethren do not wake up. So not only hunting... we need a more innovative method."
The dangers of hunting have been proven more than enough by this incident. There is no rule saying that such a problem won't occur again.
"Trade... we should consider trading or forming alliances with the surface."
"Do you have any power on the surface in mind?"
"Gipell, or the remnants of the human royal family. I will go out myself during the next hunt and try to make contact with them."
Meanwhile, the various leaders of the surface were receiving reports about this matter.
"Enemy tribe."
Veradin looked over the report with interest and nodded.

"Presumed to be a subspecies of the Myungwang tribe, with combat power enough not to be instantly killed by a Myungwang's sword, and incredible technology. Quite appealing friends, these enemy tribes."

"I'm sorry that we couldn't find out more in detail, my Lord. According to what my spirits and magicians told me, they could only approach and verify when the battle between Jin Runcandel and the enemy tribe was at its most intense."

"That's fine. You managed to return alive from Jin's vicinity and brought back a rough estimate of information, so you deserve a reward. Was it thanks to the judgment of the Phantom Legion or the ghost division of the adjudicator?"
"They said it was the judgment of my subordinates."
Satreene answered.
"Then the Ghost Division should be rewarded. I will give all members of the Ghost Division the opportunity to learn the 2nd grade magic of our family."
"Thank you, my lord. However, there is one more thing to report before we accept the reward."
"What is it?"
"It's not certain, but there are rumors that something other than our magicians might have been on the battlefield."
"Something else?"
"Yes, they said it was extremely difficult to sense it, so it's presumed to be Yona Runcandel or unknown assassins... but it was impossible to verify."
"Hmm, it must be one of the two anyway. Either the Vamel Alliance or someone sent by the remnants of the royal family."
"Are there such capable people in the remnants of the royal family?"

"I don't know much about them either. That's why we always have to keep the remnants of the royal family in mind. They may be keeping a low profile because they are currently weak, but we should assume that they can resurface at any time."
"Yes, I understand."

"If it is the remnants of the royal family, they will surely try to contact the enemy tribe, so we must be careful. Send people to the imperial territories that the remnants of the royal family have released. We'll have to work on the high-ranking officials of the royal family remaining there."
"Yes, my Lord."
"And I will give the Phantom Legion the opportunity to learn 3rd grade magic."
"......Thank you."
Like he did to Kadun, Veradin was deliberately suppressing Octavia's spirits. All those who were major figures in Kelliark were receiving similar treatment.
But Octavia and the others didn't dare express dissatisfaction. Showing loyalty by prostrating themselves was the only way to survive in the family.
"We need to make contact with them and have a conversation. The Phantom Legion commander and the adjudicator should continue to send wizards to find their whereabouts."
"Understood."

"Convey to the writers under me an immediate order to write a follow-up article. Something like 'The enemy tribe has been revived due to Jin and Kinzelo, and it's threatening the tax revenue' should be appropriate."
"Yes, I will make sure the news spreads throughout the federation today."
"Good. I will go to the holy place and see if the shaman can help. If we can get the technology of the enemy tribe, we can hasten the time to strike our enemies."
The meeting of Gipell ended that way.
At the same time, the Vermont royal family was also having a similar meeting.

On a deserted island located in the northern sea of the Lutero Federation, the remnants of the Vermont royal family were hiding here since the Shrine of the Evil Gods, and had stopped their activities.
"Rakiman Hog... really a name I haven't heard in a long time. He's still arrogant and making mistakes. Shimat must be frustrated."
He spoke as if he knew Rakiman Hog. The royals sitting next to him also nodded as if they knew Rakiman.
Airan Vermont, the figure who has led the remaining royals and followers ever since former Emperor Amir Vermont was executed.

He tried to assassinate Dante after receiving Yona's soul from Joshua before the Shrine of Evil Gods, and during the Shrine, he sent Mines including Ratz to try to kill key figures of the Vamel Alliance.
Despite this, there is little known about Airan in the world.
There was no reason to be spotlighted since his succession order was only in the 30s before Amir ascended the throne, and he never exposed himself due to the mysticism of the Vermont royal family.
However, the 'oldest' beings of the Vermont royal family.

In other words, the royals who have been watching the Vermont royal family that has existed for thousands of years from the beginning to now have always regarded Airan Vermont as the real emperor from then until now.
Only Airan is the only emperor of the Vermont Empire, and hundreds of emperors known to the outside world were all just smokescreens to hide secrets.
Airan and the royals sitting next to him have been hiding in the royal family, changing their names and appearance for a long time. They were the origin of the royal family's mysticism.
"Bivol, you've worked hard. The harvest is very large."
The royal called Bivol nodded. He was the one who secretly watched the battle of Jin along with the wizards of Zipple.
"Thank you, Your Majesty."

"Finally, the opportunity to reclaim and revive our empire has come. The underground forces, including the enemy tribes, will still be obsessed with the resurrection of the Sun God, so we must use that fact to create a situation where our enemies and they annihilate each other."
At Airan's words, the eyes of the royals became sharp. They must have thought that there wasn't much time left to hide under the name of mysticism.

"In order to do that, we first need to help the enemy tribe regain its strength..... Bivol, go to their castle right now and propose a deal. With the content that we will provide a large amount of nutrients. You remember the location of the Patlok castle, right?"
"Yes, Your Majesty."

"Good. They will definitely accept the deal. But given the characteristics of the enemy tribe, when they are full, they will lose their minds and prepare to stab us in the back, so we need to lure them with a sweeter bait."
"What more should I convey to the enemy tribe?"
At that, Airan laughed and added the following.
"Tell them that if they don't betray us to the end, when the time comes, we will let them know the whereabouts of the enemy tribe's god."
